subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken states and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community providers?
rationale: This would define support guarantees, metadata ownership, and user-facing lifecycle semantics across provider surfaces, not just add a missing docs table.

options.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with provider, model family, capability, status, deadline, replacement, owner, and issue-link fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

options.title: Publish docs-only policy first
options.body: Start with a human-readable provider support and deprecation policy before committing to machine-readable registry or CLI output.

options.title: Defer broad guarantees
options.body: Keep provider status limited to live probe/catalog metadata and handle provider breakages as provider-specific issues until maintainers want lifecycle commitments.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with provider, model family, capability, status, deadline, replacement, owner, and issue-link fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.
